description: Time zone and date math. action=now returns the current time in one or more IANA zones; convert moves a time from from_tz to to_tz (to_tz may be a list); diff returns the duration between time and to; add adds days/hours/minutes. Daylight saving time is handled. Use it for scheduling across zones or date arithmetic. Limits: IANA zone names only (e.g. America/New_York); no calendars or holidays.

time.description: ISO 8601 or 'now'; without offset = wall time in from_tz
